name: National governments
desc: Set laws, budgets, labour rules, building codes and social protection.

name: City and local governments
desc: Run heat action plans, urban design, housing and local services.

name: Health authorities
desc: Prepare clinics, track heat illness and deaths, and lead public health warnings.

name: Weather and climate services
desc: Forecast dangerous heat and trigger warnings and early action.

name: Employers and businesses
desc: Decide on rest breaks, shade, water, working hours and sick pay.

name: Worker organisations and unions
desc: Organise informal and formal workers to win protection and income security.

name: Utilities and energy regulators
desc: Keep power flowing, price electricity and shape how cooling is supplied.

name: Water authorities
desc: Manage supply, pumping, treatment and how scarce water is shared.

name: Farmers’ organisations and agriculture agencies
desc: Shape what is grown, how water is used and how soils are managed.

name: Schools and education authorities
desc: Decide on classrooms, timetables and support that keeps children learning.

name: Banks, insurers and financial regulators
desc: Price risk, design insurance and lending, set prudential rules and decide where capital flows. They include central banks, commercial and farm banks, and microfinance lenders.

name: Development banks, donors and climate funds
desc: Finance prevention, protection and the institutions that deliver them.

name: Community and civil society groups
desc: Reach the people institutions miss: checking on neighbours, running cooling spaces, and giving people a voice in decisions.

name: International bodies
desc: Set global standards and agreements on emissions, refrigerants and work.
